messages:
Elaine Wu: Heads-up, HelixHealth follow-up — they asked for committed Dedicated capacity across us-west-2 + eu-west-1. Need an offer we can defend on availability and cost before tomorrow's SOW review.

Sam Carter: Quick signal check from metrics they shared: steady ~10-14 req/s p95, morning spike to ~28-32 req/s. Using our perf model (2048 tokens) that's ~0.75-0.85 A100-eq per req/s. Ballpark math: steady -> 9-12 GPUs, peak -> 22-28 GPUs.

Priya Nair: For SOW we should frame two options: guaranteed commit (fixed monthly) vs. commit+shared-burst. For an enterprise with strict SLOs I prefer: guaranteed 14 GPUs + shared burst 8 GPUs. Add a 15-20% operational buffer for maintenance windows.

Marco Diaz: FYI eu-west-1 A100 capacity tight in May/June due to partner reservations. If Helix insists on physical eu-west placement we should either: (1) reduce guaranteed GPUs there and route noncritical work to L4s, or (2) provide failover routing to us-west-2 with data-residency caveats.

capacity-bot: Headroom snapshot (30d outlook): us-west-2 = 1,080 A100-eq GPU-hours free; eu-west-1 = 360 A100-eq GPU-hours free. Planned reservations: eu-west-1 2026-05-08 -> 2026-06-30 (partners).

Jiro Tanaka: Operational proposal to meet their SLOs while limiting cost:

- Guarantee 14 A100-eq GPUs pinned to tenant (no preempt)
- Shared burst pool of 8 A100-eq GPUs (best-effort, preemptible, 60-90s drain)
- Autoscale warmers: pre-warm 2 nodes when queued burst > 2 GPUs to keep cold-starts < 2m
- Maintenance buffer: 20% reserved headroom inside tenant allocation for planned ops

Sam Carter: Pricing and billing terms (draft):
- Committed tier: 14 GPUs/month at committed rate
- Burst: access to shared pool, billed only if used beyond grace
- Overage: 1.3x committed unit rate; first 5% overage free for 60 days
- Ramp: optional 3-month linear ramp from 50% -> 100% commit to smooth provisioning costs

Priya Nair: Also recommend clause for region shortfall: if we cannot deliver >=80% of guaranteed in eu-west-1 for >72 consecutive hours, grant either temporary credits equal to X GPU-hours or complimentary burst access until capacity restored. Keeps customer relationship healthy.

Marco Diaz: Suggest we map guaranteed GPUs to per-region buckets in the SOW: 10 in us-west-2, 4 in eu-west-1 (initial). That respects current capacity and gives them geo redundancy. If they need 8 in eu-west-1, price premium or convert some to L4s for noncritical routes.

Elaine Wu: Can someone give me a 3-line customer-friendly summary I can paste into the SOW?

Sam Carter: Short SOW bullets for HelixHealth:
- 14 committed A100-equivalent GPUs (monthly) split 10 us-west-2 / 4 eu-west-1
- 8 GPU shared burst pool for spikes (best-effort)
- 20% operational buffer + 3-month ramp option
- Overage at 1.3x after 5% grace; region-fallback credits if eu-west shortfall >72h

Priya Nair: + add: automatic routing to us-west-2 for non-sensitive workloads if eu-west cannot meet capacity, with explicit data-residency exceptions listed.

Elaine Wu: Perfect. I'll send that to Legal/Sales and call it out in tomorrow's meeting. Closing thread for now — will reopen if the SOW counter arrives. :thumbsup:
